context: Pach conjectured in 1980 [28] that for every convex set D there is an m such that any finite set of points admits a 2-coloring such that any translate of D that contains at least m points contains both colors. This conjecture inspired a series of papers studying the problem and its variants – for a recent survey, see [31]. Eventually, the conjecture was shown to hold in the case when D is a convex polygon in a series of papers [29, 41, 37], but disproved in general [30]. In fact, the conjecture fails for any D with a smooth boundary, e.g., for a disk.
